tree.heading: Exclusive Jurisdiction.—
tree.text: An amateur sports organization that conducts amateur athletic competition shall have exclusive jurisdiction over that competition if participation is restricted to a specific class of amateur athletes, such as high school students, college students, members of the Armed Forces, or similar groups or categories.

tree.heading: Sanctions for International Competition.—
tree.text: An amateur sports organization under subsection (a) of this section shall obtain a sanction from the appropriate national governing body if the organization wishes to—

children.text: conduct international amateur athletic competition in the United States; or
sponsor international amateur athletic competition to be held outside the United States.
